name: Copper Fungicide Spray
description: Highly effective broad-spectrum fungicide. Treats powdery mildew, leaf blights, and downy mildew. Copper-based formula approved for organic use.

name: Neem-Based Treatment
description: Cold-pressed neem oil concentrate. Controls early-stage pest infestations, powdery mildew, and aphids. Chemical-free and safe for pollinators.

name: Chlorantraniliprole Insecticide
description: Systemic insecticide targeting stem borers, leaf folders, and thrips. Long-lasting residual activity up to 3 weeks.

name: Sulfur Dust (Wettable)
description: Wettable sulfur powder for powdery mildew and rust diseases. Can be used as both spray and dust.

name: Mancozeb Fungicide
description: Contact fungicide with multi-site action against early blight, late blight, and anthracnose.

name: Trichoderma Bio-Fungicide
description: Biological soil treatment using beneficial Trichoderma fungi. Prevents root rot, damping-off, and fusarium wilt.

name: Soil Moisture Sensor
description: Capacitive soil moisture sensor with digital readout. Connects to irrigation system. IP67 waterproof.

name: Drip Irrigation Kit
description: Complete drip irrigation setup for 1 bigha. Includes mainline, lateral pipes, drippers, filters, and fittings.

name: Potassium Fertilizer (SOP)
description: Sulfate of Potash for improving fruit quality, disease resistance, and drought tolerance. Low chloride.

name: Calcium Boron Spray
description: Foliar spray for calcium and boron deficiency. Prevents blossom end rot and tip burn.
